attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 6 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The same day's calendar keeps Paul the Confessor, archbishop of Constantinople, in a separate entry, and nothing on either page joins the two. saint.gr also keeps a Paul who was bishop of Corinth and brother of Peter of Argos on 27 Μαρτίου, whom the corpus holds as `paul-of-corinth`; that page makes him a bishop of the city and this one a fool for Christ from it, and nothing joins them either. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
